hook_tournament.why: $3,000 anchors a story you already understand—bot disrupting agencies—so you'd swipe for proof. 'Went free' is too cryptic and vague, making you solve a riddle instead of believing a story.

candidates: VIDEO AGENCIES CHARGE $3,000. GROK BOT CHARGES NOTHING
5 VIDEOS GROK BOT MAKES FREE THAT VIDEO AGENCIES CHARGE $3,000 FOR
5 VIDEOS AGENCIES BILL YOU $3,000 FOR. GROK BOT MAKES THEM FREE
hook_sharpen.why: [2] hits harder because 'BILL YOU' makes the pain personal and accusatory—I feel like the victim this solves for—while the two short sentences parse in one breath. [1] has the same specificity but awkward word order ('MAKES FREE THAT CHARGE') costs it a beat of readability.
